name: Bang & Olufsen Beoplay P2 Pocket Bluetooth Speaker (Fair)
description: Bang & Olufsen Beoplay P2 pocket Bluetooth speaker, sold honestly at a fair price for its fair condition. This palm-sized aluminum speaker delivers surprisingly big, crisp B&O sound with about 10 hours of battery life, Bluetooth connectivity, and USB-C charging. Functionally 100% working — the 'fair' grade is purely cosmetic: the aluminum shell has visible scuffs, light scratches, and minor corner dings from daily pocket carry. Priced accordingly, way below used-market asking for mint examples. Transparently from a pet-friendly home (a cat lives here), but it has been wiped clean. Does NOT come with an extra storage pouch — please bring your own bag for pickup.

name_zh: B&O（Bang & Olufsen）Beoplay P2 口袋蓝牙音箱（成色一般·低价）
description_zh: 转让 Bang & Olufsen（B&O）Beoplay P2 口袋蓝牙音箱，成色一般所以明码低价，诚实出售。这款掌心大小的铝合金音箱能发出远超体积的清澈 B&O 声音，续航约 10 小时，支持蓝牙与 USB-C 充电。功能 100% 正常——标 fair 纯粹是外观问题：铝合金外壳有日常放口袋留下的明显划痕、细小磕碰和边角小凹痕，主观请知悉。价格已按瑕疵大幅下调，远低于网站上的好成色卖家价。卖家家庭养猫，音箱已擦拭清洁。不附带额外收纳袋，自提请自备小袋。
